months.thought_at_plan: This is the first month. I received an offer from X company for my house on Hatoba Street. They want to buy both the land and the building for 1.1 times the assessed value. This is the first offer I've received. I need to decide whether to sell or not. Given that this is the first month and I don't know the market dynamics or other potential buyers, I should probably hold off on selling immediately. I should gather more information and see if other offers come in. For now, I will not go anywhere and will consider the offer.

months.sell_reason: 様子を見たい
months.thought_at_decision: This is the first month, and I've received an offer for my property on Hatoba Street. The offer is from X company, for both the land and the building, at 1.1 times the assessed value. The total assessed value is 19,700,000 yen, so the offer is for 21,670,000 yen (19,700,000 * 1.1). However, the prompt states the offer is for 20,000,000 yen. I will use the value provided in the prompt for the offer amount. It seems like a good offer for the first month. The company states they are a foreign real estate investment company aiming to acquire a majority of the properties in this town. This sounds like a potentially significant change for the town. Given it's the first month and I don't know the market or other potential buyers, I should not sell immediately. I will decline the offer for now and state that I am not selling. I will also not list my property for sale this month. I will wait and see what happens in the next month.
